[Context around occurrence 1]
## 1. Monorepo Restructure

- [ ] 1.1 Create `turbo.json` at repo root with pipeline: build, dev, lint tasks and dependency graph (`packages/db` and `packages/shared` build before apps)
- [ ] 1.2 Replace repo root `package.json` with workspace root config: `"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]`, add `turbo` as dev dependency
- [ ] 1.3 Move all current Next.js files from repo root into `apps/web/` (src/, public/, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, postcss.config.mjs, components.json, eslint.config.mjs, package.json)
- [ ] 1.4 Update all `@/*` import aliases and path references inside `apps/web/` after the move
- [ ] 1.5 Create `packages/shared/` with its own `package.json` (name: `@pakabuhi/shared`), `tsconfig.json`, and `src/index.ts`
- [ ] 1.6 Add `DEFAULT_STATUSES` constant array to `packages/shared/src/statuses.ts` with all 12 default status entries (order + name + color)
- [ ] 1.7 Add feed markdown parser (`feedParser.ts`) to `packages/shared/src/` — parses `[[status:Name]]`, `**bold**`, `[text](url)` tokens
- [ ] 1.8 Add shared TypeScript types to `packages/shared/src/types.ts` (JobApplication, FeedEntry, UserProfile, Resume, CronRun interfaces)
- [ ] 1.9 Scaffold `apps/api/` with `package.json` (name: `@pakabuhi/api`), `tsconfig.json`, `src/index.ts` (Express app entry), and `.env.example`
- [ ] 1.10 Scaffold `apps/worker/` with `package.json` (name: `@pakabuhi/worker`), `tsconfig.json`, `src/index.ts` (cron entry), and `.env.example`
- [ ] 1.11 Verify `turbo dev` starts all three apps from repo root without errors

## 2. Database Schema (packages/db)

- [ ] 2.1 Create `packages/db/` with `package.json` (name: `@pakabuhi/db`), `tsconfig.json`, and move `prisma/` + `prisma.config.ts` into it
- [ ] 2.2 Write full Prisma schema with models: `User`, `Session`, `Account` (BetterAuth managed), `UserProfile`, `UserCustomStatus`, `JobApplication`, `FeedEntry`, `FeedLog`, `Resume`, `CronSettings`, `CronRun`
- [ ] 2.3 Add `UserProfile` fields: `userId`, `fullName`, `contactInfo` (JSON), `jobFunction`, `aiSummary`, `workExperience` (JSON), `education` (JSON), `skills` (JSON), `originalResumeKey`, `onboardingCompleted`
- [ ] 2.4 Add `JobApplication` fields: `userId`, `company`, `position`, `jobDescription`, `sourceUrl`, `sourceUrlHash`, `sourcePlatform`, `statusOrder`, `statusName`, `aiMatchSummary`, `resumeId` (optional FK)
- [ ] 2.5 Add `FeedEntry` fields: `jobApplicationId`, `type` (enum: system/ai/user), `contentMd`, `actor`, `hasLog`, `createdAt`; add `FeedLog` with `feedEntryId` and `content` (text)
- [ ] 2.6 Add `CronSettings` fields: `userId` (unique), `enabled`, `days` (JSON array), `startHour`, `endHour`, `timezone`
- [ ] 2.7 Add `CronRun` fields: `userId`, `status` (enum: running/completed/failed), `startedAt`, `completedAt`, `polledCount`, `filteredCount`, `generatedCount`, `appliedCount`, `failedCount`, `errorMessage`
- [ ] 2.8 Add `Resume` fields: `userId`, `jobApplicationId` (optional FK), `seaweedKey`, `sizeBytes`, `createdAt`
- [ ] 2.9 Add `UserCustomStatus` fields: `userId`, `name`, `color`, `order` (unique per user constraint)
- [ ] 2.10 Run `prisma migrate dev --name init` to create initial migration
- [ ] 2.11 Export Prisma client from `packages/db/src/index.ts` for use in `apps/api` and `apps/worker`

## 3. Docker Compose Infrastructure

- [ ] 3.1 Write `docker-compose.yml` at repo root with services: `postgres` (image: postgres:16, volume, healthcheck), `seaweedfs-master` (official image, port 9333), `seaweedfs-volume` (depends on master, port 8080), `api` (build: apps/api, port 4000, depends on postgres + seaweedfs), `web` (build: apps/web, port 3000, depends on api), `worker` (build: apps/worker, depends on postgres + seaweedfs + api)
- [ ] 3.2 Write `apps/api/Dockerfile`: Node 20 alpine base, install deps, copy packages/db and packages/shared, copy apps/api, build TypeScript, expose 4000
- [ ] 3.3 Write `apps/web/Dockerfile`: Node 20 alpine base, Next.js standalone build, expose 3000
- [ ] 3.4 Write `apps/worker/Dockerfile`: Node 20 base (not alpine — Playwright requires full libc), install Playwright browsers, copy packages, expose no port (background process)
- [ ] 3.5 Add `.dockerignore` to each app directory
- [ ] 3.6 Verify `docker compose up` starts all services and postgres healthcheck passes
